title: Choosing the Correct PIL

launchpad.outcome: Choose the PIL with structural reasoning, and reassess when a new relevant swing forms.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Why this swing, and not that one?

slides.headline: Pick the PIL. Then say why.
slides.line: Four swings. Only one is the level price has to prove itself through right now.

slides.headline: The map can update
slides.line: PIL A is active. Indication ✓, correction ✓. Watch what price does next.

slides.quote: Don’t just ask “which line?” Ask “which swing does price actually have to prove itself through right now?”

slides.prompt: Why might your active PIL change?
slides.modelAnswer: Because structure keeps developing. If price builds a new relevant swing, that swing may become the level price has to prove itself through. I reassess instead of waiting on an old line.

takeaways: Not newest, not closest, not prettiest.
remember: Structure created the PIL. The map can update.
